_comment: Metabase Admin API key, used ONLY by scripts/metabase-setup.mjs to register reporting.db and re-sync its schema. Metabase itself does NOT need this to serve dashboards -- it is our credential for calling Metabase's API, not Metabase's own configuration. Revoke and recreate from Metabase -> Admin settings -> Authentication -> API keys. secrets/ is gitignored.
